ad_intro:
Why a performance-marketing audit includes the website: Meta does not make you money - the click does. CPL is paid on the ad; the conversion happens on the landing page, the form, WhatsApp speed-to-lead and the proof. If the ad says ZunRoof and the page says 'zunsolar (previously zunroof)' forty times, you spent the click re-introducing yourself instead of selling a roof.

ZunRoof Tech Pvt Ltd, founded 2016 in Gurugram by Pranesh Chaudhary (IIT-KGP) and Sushant Sachan. Backed by the Godrej family office (ANBG Enterprise LLP), which holds 70%+; $18M raised across 11 rounds, latest Rs.25.14 Cr on 12 Sep 2025 (47,986 shares at Rs.5,239), after Rs.20 Cr in Dec 2024. Revenue band Rs.10-50 Cr (Tracxn, FY25). Day-1 file 14 Sep 2026: 7/10 HOT, ~23 ads, Lead Form dest, Rs.20 L+/mo est., pitch_fit HIGH.

Live check 14 Sep 2026: zunroof.com now resolves to zunsolar.com - the brand renamed, but the old name is still what the market, the ads and the Day-1 file carry. The homepage claims Rs.60,00,00,000 saved in electricity bills, 40,000+ happy customers, 75+ cities, India's no.1 Solar EPC, 4x YoY growth, Tier-1 panels with 25-year performance warranty, 20% booking payment, 0% EMI, a 25-day installation promise and commissioning within 50 days of layout approval. Empanelment badges: MNRE, HAREDA, PSPCL, TSREDCO. WhatsApp is live at +91 9205695690 with a pre-filled message that still says 'via zunroof.com'. Two compliance-grade copy problems: the subsidy block says 'Avail upto 40% solar subsidy on total installation cost as per Government guidelines' - PM Surya Ghar pays fixed slabs (Rs.30,000 / Rs.60,000 / Rs.78,000), not a percentage - and the ROI block promises a 'quick payback period of 3-4 years guaranteed'. The proof layer is text-only testimonials, an embedded YouTube video that returns 'Video unavailable', and a press wall dated 2019-2021 ('160% growth in FY 2021').

Day-1 leak, confirmed: static poster creatives, stock images, no roof before/after - against 40,000 real installs. Ad counts are Day-1 estimates. Never promise subsidy approval.
ad_intelligence: Ad Library is 30% of the leak. The other 70%: (1) does the landing match the hook, (2) can they WhatsApp in under 5 minutes, (3) is there proof a neighbour installed, (4) is the form short, (5) does tracking fire on WhatsApp/enquire not just PageView. zunsolar passes (2) and half of (5); it fails (1) on brand continuity, (3) on visual proof, and (4) has no short-form calculator path. That is why we audit the site, not just the ~23 creatives.

Meta (FB+IG) primary for residential; Google Search/PMax on 'solar panel price', 'rooftop solar subsidy', '<city> solar installer'. Owned: zunsolar.com + the zunsolar monitoring app. Sister brand zunpulse (smart home) shares press and brand equity. Check BOTH zunroof.com and zunsolar.com in Google Ads Transparency - a rebrand splits the transparency record.

Rs.60 Cr customer bill savings, 40,000+ customers, 75+ cities, 4x YoY growth since 2016, Tier-1 panels + 25-yr performance warranty, lifetime service promise, IoT remote monitoring app, 3D shadow-profiling site design, 20% booking payment with milestone billing, solar loans + 0% EMI, 25-day install promise, 50-day commissioning commitment, MNRE/HAREDA/PSPCL/TSREDCO empanelment. Almost none of this is in the creative.

Ad -> zunsolar.com -> 'Go Solar' enquiry + floating WhatsApp (+91 9205695690, pre-filled 'via zunroof.com'). No published price or per-kW band, no savings/payback calculator, no city landing pages despite 75+ cities, no site-survey scheduler. Testimonials are text with names, kW and city (Gurugram, Lucknow, Ghaziabad, Delhi, Mohali, Amritsar, Meerut) - excellent raw material, zero photos or video.
Compliance risk to fix before scaling spend

'Avail upto 40% solar subsidy on total installation cost' is not how PM Surya Ghar works in 2026 - it is Rs.30,000 / Rs.60,000 / Rs.78,000 for 1/2/3+ kW, paid by DBT, with loans at 5.75%. 'Payback 3-4 years guaranteed' is an outcome guarantee. Both invite disputes and Meta ad rejections. Restate as exact slabs plus 'MNRE process; zunsolar does not approve subsidy'.
findings: You are paying a rebrand tax on every click (confirmed 14 Sep 2026). zunroof.com now resolves to zunsolar.com, and the new site says 'zunsolar (previously zunroof)' in nearly every paragraph, testimonial and press headline - even the WhatsApp deep link still ends 'via zunroof.com'. Search demand, the Day-1 record and probably the ad account still say ZunRoof. Decide the ad-facing name, run one clean 301 map, update the WhatsApp prefill and the Google Ads Transparency domain, and stop spending media money explaining a name change mid-funnel.

The subsidy line is wrong for 2026 and is a compliance risk. The page offers 'upto 40% solar subsidy on total installation cost as per Government guidelines'. PM Surya Ghar pays fixed central assistance - Rs.30,000 (1 kW), Rs.60,000 (2 kW), Rs.78,000 (3 kW and above) - by DBT, with scheme loans at 5.75%. A percentage promise over-states small systems, under-states nothing, and creates cancelled orders at DISCOM stage. Replace it with the exact slab table plus 'MNRE process; zunsolar does not approve subsidy'. Same treatment for 'payback period of 3-4 years guaranteed' - model it, do not guarantee it.

Day-1 leak confirmed: stock posters sitting on top of 40,000 real installs. The creative is static posters and stock imagery with no roof before/after - while the site itself lists named customers with capacity and city: 17 kW Gurugram, 11 kW Delhi, 9 kW Zirakpur, 7 kW Lucknow, 6 kW Amritsar, 5 kW Meerut, 3 kW Mohali. That is a ready-made shoot list. The one embedded YouTube video on the homepage returns 'Video unavailable'. In a category where PM Surya Ghar is adding ~16,328 installs a day, the brand with 40,000 roofs should own the UGC feed, not the stock library.

No price, no calculator - the highest-intent question is unanswered. There is no per-kW band, no system pricing and no savings/payback tool anywhere on zunsolar.com. '20% booking payment' and '0% EMI' are strong commercial hooks buried in body copy. A 3-field calculator (city, monthly bill, roof type) that captures the phone number before showing the number typically lifts form completion 1.5-2x and gives the ad account a mid-funnel conversion event to optimise on.

75+ cities, zero city pages. Testimonials span Gurugram, Lucknow, Ghaziabad, Faridabad, Greater Noida, Delhi, Meerut, Mohali, Dera Bassi, Zirakpur, Amritsar - and empanelment covers HAREDA (Haryana), PSPCL (Punjab), TSREDCO (Telangana). None of it is expressed as a city landing page or a localised ad set, so the Haryana/Punjab DISCOM advantage never shows up in the auction. Build 8-10 city pages with local installs, local DISCOM process and the local net-metering timeline.

The proof wall stopped updating in 2021. Press links are Financial Express, ToI, The Hindu, ET, CNBC-TV18 and Business World - all 2019-2021, headlined '160% growth in FY 2021'. Meanwhile the actual news is current and far stronger: Godrej family office holds 70%+, Rs.25.14 Cr raised on 12 Sep 2025, $18M total across 11 rounds. Godrej-backed is a trust asset in a category where homeowners fear the installer disappearing before the net meter arrives - put it in the creative and above the fold.
competitors: City landing pages, 15k+ Google ratings, savings calculator, subsidy rupees on the first screen, heavy install UGC.
You have 40,000 installs across 75+ cities and publish neither a calculator nor a city page. This is a pure execution gap, not a budget gap.
Freyr's hero is 'Save Rs.1 Lakh'; Oorjan leads with financing. Both make the money math the headline.
Your money story - 20% booking, 0% EMI, Rs.60 Cr saved, 3-4 year payback - is in paragraph four. Move it to the ad.
Balance-sheet trust, exact CFA slabs per SKU, DCR/ALMM clarity, DISCOM familiarity.
Godrej family office at 70%+ is your answer to the trust objection - and you never say it. State the slabs correctly and the trust gap closes.
Same-day WhatsApp quote, neighbourhood install photos, 48-hour survey.
You already have WhatsApp 9205695690 and a 25-day install promise. Add speed-to-lead SLA and terrace proof and you beat them on both trust and speed.
